goal: Independent review of the lead's P0/P1 changes before release. AX Branch must run the whole lifecycle inside the app: runs must survive the window, an Owner stop must never be auto-resumed, automatic recovery must stay bounded, large deliverables must be built by edits, and the live view must show only real state with zero LLM calls.
task: Review the diff `git diff a52fa9b~1..HEAD -- axbranch axbranch_app.py` (commits a52fa9b, 960a84, 957f9d6). Do NOT modify any file. Look for concrete defects only (no style): (1) supervisor.since_owner + AXB_SUPERVISED: can automatic recovery loop forever, or can an Owner action be lost/miscounted? (2) gui._launch detached + gui.stop: duplicate workers, a stop that leaves a running tree, a stop that the supervisor resumes, frozen exe (`AXBranch.exe run <id>`) dispatch problems; (3) run_lock(wait=2) and engine._status_write: can a real second session now start, or can a status write still crash the engine? (4) BUILD_EDITS / EDITS_ONLY_ABOVE in engine._executing: cases where a needed full rebuild becomes impossible, or the edit_rule text is wrong; (5) live.view/live.records: any path that shows a stage as running when it is not, any exception on old plans (no 'why', missing keys), any write or LLM call. For each defect give file:line, a concrete failing scenario, and the minimal fix. If you find none in an area, say so explicitly.
contract: Review only. No file changes. Findings must be concrete and verifiable from the code.
constraints: Do not edit, create or delete files. Do not commit. Be specific and brief.
expected_output: Report with sections FINDINGS (numbered: severity, file:line, scenario, fix) and NO-DEFECT AREAS.
